text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *pant*... ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—There's no need to resist anymore, is there?
After all, everyone already knows.”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That you are... absolutely, utterly scandalous...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...N-No...
I... I am—

The summer training camp progressed smoothly, and Still in Love
was steadily gaining strength. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san... I'm sorry... I know it's... e-earlier than scheduled... but...
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take a break.
Yeah, let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...
choice_data_list: (Man, this exhaustion is just too much...)

text_block_list.text: We haven't been pushing her that hard. The heat might be part of why she's so exhausted, but another possibility is――
choice_data_list: Still... are you holding back your instincts?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Really, I'm...
supposed to keep myself under control..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"As I get stronger, it feels like that girl is gaining power too...
It takes everything I have just to keep her suppressed..."
choice_data_list: I see... Sorry for not noticing sooner.
I see... Sorry I didn't notice.

text_block_list.text:
...We should face those instincts once more.
By pitting her against strong rivals who push her in simulated races,
we must find a way for her to seize the initiative.
choice_data_list: Let's set up a match race for tomorrow. Your opponent will be—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —There is no need to search.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
2,000 meters, clockwise.
choice_data_list: (To think she'd be the one to step forward.)

text_block_list.text: Her current active rival, Admire Groove... True, facing her would serve as practice for controlling her instincts, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um... Alv-san.
Why... so suddenly...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Because I want to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was defeated by you.
That is why I wish to find a clue to victory.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That is all.
If you are done preparing—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin.
Otherwise, this will just become a nuisance.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Oh.
(Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Look, the rumors were true!
Those two are really going to race!
I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's all the racket?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"It's a race showdown between the two biggest names.
Of course it's going to make a fuss."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I never thought it'd turn into something like this.
I'm so glad I kept an eye on the Umamusume's social media.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You, what press are you with?
Why are you here? Who gave you permission—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you have time to mind me?
It's about to start!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Will the Double Tiara Umamusume score a landslide victory, or will the prodigy awaken once more...? ...Well, gotta bet on the Double Tiara, right?

—The result defied almost everyone's expectations.
Admire Groove's legs had grown dramatically sharper in this short span of time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...! 
I won't—lose again...!

With a dazzling late burst of speed, Admire Groove
closed in on the leading Still in Love.
Meanwhile, Still in Love was...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... what a pleasant temperature...!
Hey, hey... play with me moreee!!
choice_data_list: (This is bad, she's out of control...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't Alv-san totally insane!?
Surging from behind with that incredible stretch drive...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "‘The Prodigy Awakens: Double Tiara Umamusume Completely Crushed—The Comeback Starts Now’... Yep, that's the headline!"
choice_data_list: (Expectations are... being completely rewritten...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *pant*..., ...*gasp*.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...See?
I wasn't wrong after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
While you've been dallying with things like "bonds"...
I've been growing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...All I have is racing.
You are different. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The one who deserves to win is me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Alv-san really... dislikes me,
doesn't she?"
choice_data_list: ...I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Because those eyes... were so cold.
I wonder what I did wrong..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't worry too much about it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-san...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What happened with her isn't your fault.
So, you don't need to beat yourself up over it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Still...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...She doesn't know love.
That's why I refuse to lose to someone who has it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. What that person hates isn't you.
—It is love itself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Convincing herself that she has nothing other than racing...
Man, she really is a handful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...It would be nice to have someone to support one another with, just like you two do."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it's not like you're disliked.
I just wanted to tell you not to worry. Also—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Please don't resent her.
As a rival of the same generation—

Afterward, Still in Love appeared deep in thought for a while.
Even after all training had finished...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: ...Hey. Want to take a short walk?
...Hey. Want to go for a short walk?

text_block_list.text:
We walked together along the deserted beach.
...After a while, I realized she was walking
a few paces behind me.
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Come sit next to me.
What's wrong? Come sit next to me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
...I'm sorry, it's just out of habit...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine like this.
It calms me down, so..."
choice_data_list: ...Is it really no good?
Then I'll come stand next to you!
Then I'll go stand next to them!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine like this.
It calms me down, so..."
choice_data_list: ...Is it really no good?
Then I'll come stand next to you!
Then I'll go stand next to them!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: If you don't like it, that's fine though

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It's not that I dislike it...!
choice_data_list: I want to face you and talk to you.
I want to face you and talk.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.
choice_data_list: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't help but think it was unfair.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Does that mean...—
choice_data_list: Ei!

text_block_list.text:
Taking a big leap backward,
I lined up next to Still in Love.
She looked slightly taken aback—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu!
She gave a small smile in return.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't help but think it was unfair.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Alv-san, you must know what love is.
Because... so many people love you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san, and the fans too...
are cheering for her.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if I win the Double Tiara—
I won't be loved."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Because she's a "monster"...
choice_data_list: Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...Running any further and continuing to lay bare my instincts... terrifies me."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Deep down, as I thought... I was never meant to be here—
choice_data_list: I want you by my side.
I want you here with me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh!?
choice_data_list: I'll be waiting for your victory.
I'm waiting for your victory.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: I will always, without a doubt, stay by your side.
I'll definitely stay on your side no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: ...Am I that unreliable?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: No!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...No...
--It is more than enough."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I won't hesitate anymore.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"—From here, you can see
the full moon so clearly..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Hey... you contrarian.
Yes, I'm talking about you.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
"How unusual.
For you to seek me out, of all things."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Our objective should be one and the same.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I will bring victory to milady.
And for you, a race against the strongest...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —We join our forces together.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "At the Shuka Sho, I'll set up the 'most delicious moment' for you to savor to your heart's content."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Starve.
—Still in Love.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Denied the prey right before your eyes,
your hunger drives you wild, eyes bloodshot with frenzy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Starving, parched with thirst...
unable to bear it any longer. That's when—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Finally, prey is at hand. Right there—you will devour everything. Down to the very bone..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I wonder.
With this... we are both fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
...Aha♡
Are you sure? Doing something like that...

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: —Evvvveryone might end up hating you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
Because the one I want... is only one person.

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
So you've made up your mind.
...In that case—

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: Let me savor... a supreme race.
